arStrings.szText: Casting {c_important}Dark Prison{/c} refreshes and creates a link to your last prison, enemies that cross the line will be Pulled into the new prison. {c_important}Dark Prison{/c} gains an additional charge.

{c_important}Dark Prison{/c} now lasts {c_number}[{SF_14}*100|%|]{/c} longer but you can only have one at a time. When the prison ends all enemies within take {c_number}{payload:IMPLOSION}{/c} damage, increased by {c_number}[{SF_16}*100|%|]{/c} per additional enemy within. Non-Elite enemies within the prison cannot die while it is active. Recast to collapse the prison early.

{c_important}Dark Prison{/c} becomes a {c_important}Hellfire{/c} Skill and now creates an aura of fire chains around you, reducing damage coming from outside by {c_number}[{SF_8}*100|%|]{/c} and Slowing enemies within by {c_number}[{SF_9}|%|]{/c}.
Enemies killed within {c_important}Dark Prison{/c} reduce its cooldown by {c_number}[{SF_18}|1|]{/c} seconds.
Small Missiles that enter {c_important}Dark Prison{/c} are Slowed by {c_number}[{SF_20}*100|%|]{/c}.
Hitting enemies within {c_important}Dark Prison{/c} {c_important}{u}Fortifies{/u}{/c} you for {c_number}[{SF_19}*100|%|]{/c} Maximum Life {c_number}([PlayerHealthMax() * SF_19]){/c}.
